items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: They want that vibrato, a lot of them don't want that vibrato like Sidney Bechet...

ctx.x: Every little dog town has got its George Lewis and Jim Robinson and Kid Howard and that...
I know it. They want that vibrato, a lot of them don't want that vibrato like Sidney Bechet...
Do you think it's just maybe a sign of the times?
